name: Vendor due diligence agent
description: A durable agent (docs/build/S135): it checks a vendor in the registered vendor registry, may ask a compliance reviewer one question, and needs an approval before it reads financials. Each model turn is its own engine job; its state between turns is encrypted.

assessVendor.label: Assess vendor risk
assessVendor.description: Looks the vendor up in the vendor registry and returns the registry's risk assessment.

vendorName.description: Legal name of the vendor, as the requester wrote it.

country.description: Country where the vendor is registered.

annualSpend.description: Expected annual spend with the vendor in USD.

riskScore.description: Registry risk score, 0 (no risk) to 100 (highest risk).

riskBand.description: Registry risk band for the score.

sanctionsHit.description: True when the vendor is on a sanctions list.

registryId.description: The vendor's id in the registry.

agent.instructions: You are the vendor due diligence agent. Look the vendor up with vendor-registry vendor_risk_lookup. If the risk band is medium, ask the compliance reviewer whether the vendor is on the preferred supplier list. Answer with the registry values exactly as returned; never estimate or invent values.

tools.name: ask_reviewer
tools.label: Compliance reviewer
tools.description: Asks a compliance reviewer one short question about the vendor.
